text.en:
Section three of Act Numbered Twenty-nine hundred and forty-one, as amended, is hereby
further amended to read as follows:
"Section 3. Salaries of judges of first instance.- The judges of first instance of the fifth, ninth, twelfth,
fourteenth, nineteenth, twentieth, twenty-second, twenty-third, and twenty-sixth judicial districts shall receive
an annual salary of ten thousand pesos each; those of the third, sixth, seventh, eleventh, thirteenth, fifteenth,
and seventeenth, nine thousand pesos; and those of the other judicial districts and the auxiliary judges of first
instance, eight thousand pesos. The clerk of the Supreme Court, six thousand pesos."

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, December 4, 1926.
